ctaHeading: Need a TV Repair in Hillside? Let's Fix It.
aboutText: Eran Electronics, operating as TV Repairs Melbourne, has been serving Hillside since 1985. Owner and lead technician Osman Mehmed, with an RMIT engineering degree, provides unrivalled service and peace of mind for all TV repair needs. Call us for a fair go on your television repairs.
servicesText: We specialise in repairing all types of televisions and electronics. From LCD and LED to Plasma and OLED, our expert team ensures your devices are back in perfect working order.
